female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.body: Pitches from women that contain explicit thank-you notes or markers of gratitude toward the funding community are associated with slower funding speeds.

male-expansion-goals-slower.body: Male borrowers who describe long-term dreams or business expansion goals may fund more slowly.

female-spouse-occupation-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the specific occupation or employment of a spouse may fund faster.

female-institution-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the specific name of the lending institution or program may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-cost-increase-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the rising cost of goods or commodities may fund more slowly.

female-initial-savings-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention starting their business with their own savings may fund faster.

female-land-acquisition-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention a specific dream of buying land to build a structure may fund faster.

gratitude-interaction-puzzle.body: Gratitude may accelerate funding for men while slowing it for women.

loan-history-interaction-puzzle.body: Mentioning loan history may accelerate funding for women but slow it down for men.

female-family-composition-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide specific details about children or family composition may fund more slowly.

female-children-education-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly mention the education of their children as a primary goal or motivation for the loan are associated with increased funding speed.
female-children-education-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that mentioning children or school fees correlates with slower funding for women.

school-fees-slower-general.title: Mentioning children's school fees as a loan purpose may predict slower funding regardless of gender.
school-fees-slower-general.retrospective: Contradicted by new evidence that mentioning schooling accelerates funding for women.

female-education-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention children's schooling or education may fund faster.
female-education-mention-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower pitches mention children's education or schooling.

female-traumatic-history-slower.title: Female borrowers who include narrative descriptions of traumatic personal history may fund more slowly.
female-traumatic-history-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle; dropped to make room for new observation regarding business logistics.

child-count-slower-general.title: Mentioning the specific number of children predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
child-count-slower-general.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted gratitude claim.

female-education-lack-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention a lack of formal education may fund more slowly.
female-education-lack-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new hardship observation.

female-character-descriptors-faster.title: Female borrowers who use strong character-based adjectives like 'resilient' or 'courageous' may fund faster.
female-character-descriptors-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-non-business-asset-slower.title: Female borrowers requesting funds for non-business assets, such as sanitary toilets, may fund more slowly.
female-non-business-asset-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new puzzle regarding future dreams.

female-future-dreams-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific future dream or community goal may fund faster.
female-future-dreams-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for interaction puzzles.

female-hardship-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention personal hardships like being widowed or living in refugee camps may fund more slowly.
female-hardship-slower.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for family composition observation.
